    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    man_patches = image_patch.find("man")
    
    if not man_patches:
        return "No man found in the image."
    
    man_patch = max(man_patches, key=lambda man: man.compute_depth())
    glasses_patches = man_patch.find("glasses")
    
    if not glasses_patches:
        return "No glasses found on the man."
    
    glasses_patch = glasses_patches[0]
    left_distance = abs(glasses_patch.left - man_patch.left)
    right_distance = abs(glasses_patch.right - man_patch.right)
    
    if left_distance < right_distance:
        return "The man is wearing glasses on his left side."
    else:
        return "The man is wearing glasses on his right side."

        return glasses_outside_camera[0]
    
    return glasses_patches[0]

def find_yellow_shirt(image):
    import numpy as np
    from typing import List

    # Initialize the ImagePatch object
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)

    # Find all patches of objects matching "yellow shirt"
    yellow_shirt_patches = image_patch.find("yellow shirt")

    # If no patches found, return a message
    if not yellow_shirt_patches:
        return "No yellow shirts found in the image."

    # If patches found, return the coordinates of the one with the largest area
    yellow_shirt_patches.sort(key=lambda patch: np.prod(patch.cropped_image.shape[:2]))
    best_match = yellow_shirt_patches[-1]

    return f"Yellow shirt found at coordinates: left={best_match.left}, lower={best_match.lower}, right={best_match.right}, upper={best_match.upper}"

    # Get all patches in the image
    patches = image_patch.find("all")

    distances = [(patch, distance(patch, ImagePatch(None, right=math.inf, lower=math.inf))) for patch in patches]

    return distances[0][0]
